items.title: Cloudflare Quick Tunnels
items.summary: Cloudflare has introduced Quick Tunnels, a new feature that allows developers to expose local servers to the internet without complex configurations. This simplifies the development process and enhances collaboration by enabling easy sharing of local applications.

items.title: Saving another 100TB of RAM with math (and Rust)
items.summary: Cloudflare's latest blog post details their innovative approach to saving 100TB of RAM through mathematical optimizations implemented in Rust. This advancement not only improves resource efficiency but also showcases the potential of Rust in high-performance computing environments.

items.title: US Military had close call after using AI for hallucinated intelligence report
items.summary: A recent incident involving the US Military highlights the risks of relying on AI-generated intelligence, as a hallucinated report nearly led to a significant misjudgment. This serves as a critical reminder for developers and engineers about the importance of validating AI outputs in high-stakes environments.

items.title: OpenJev
items.summary: OpenJev has launched as an open-source project aimed at providing developers with tools for building and managing Java applications more efficiently. This initiative promotes collaboration and innovation within the Java community, making it easier for developers to contribute and enhance their projects.

items.title: Android 17 is the first since 3.x to add new APIs without releasing to the AOSP
items.summary: Android 17 has introduced new APIs that are not part of the Android Open Source Project (AOSP), marking a significant shift in how Android updates are managed. This change may impact developers by limiting access to new features unless they are part of the proprietary ecosystem.
